data.title: Rejection of your MRT cost reimbursement claim
data.summary: Beispiel Ersatzkasse rejects Lina Mustermeier's claim for reimbursement of a private MRI (MRT) examination under § 13 Abs. 3 SGB V, stating she did not contact the insurer before the treatment. An objection (Widerspruch) can be filed within one month of notification.
data.explanation: Your health insurer refused to pay back the cost of a private MRI scan because you did not ask for approval before the treatment, which the law requires for this kind of reimbursement claim. You may decide to file an objection (Widerspruch), in writing or by declaring it to record at the insurer's office, and the app shows the deadline for this. If you do not act in time, the rejection becomes final and you will not be reimbursed. If you are unsure about your chances, a patient advice service or lawyer can help you assess whether an objection is worthwhile.

key_facts.quote: Widerspruch ist innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe dieses Schreibens bei der Beispiel Ersatzkasse möglich, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.
